by Sandra Lo

SINGAPORE (14 January)-Tourists in the
know have been coming for years to the old
pier-based seafood restaurant in the shape of
a ship. -[1]-. The restaurant, Salty Sea,
still stands, but the familiar wooden doors
with their porthole windows are closed. All

November, and the place is set to be
demolished next month. - [2] -.

stands. - [3] -. A ccording to Mr. Kapoor,
PG Realty had decided to have the building
torn down because the structure itself would
